cost_findings: PolynomialTime is an existential fixed polynomial in complete encoded input weight.
Supplied-word tree work and physical-machine time are different seams.
The physical compiler accounts for packing, online work, stack overhead, erase, and output unpacking.
FirstSuccessProgram.retry maps all trial words before firstSome; cost cannot assume later trials are skipped.
No comparison of 170 and 1288 proves an end-to-end speedup because P_L and P_U are different polynomials.
No exact expected-time sampler or bounded-table counting extension follows from the local bounded-sampling draft.

ideal_scale_route.statement:
∀ {I J : Type u} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : LinearOrder I] [inst_3 : LinearOrder J] (r : I → ℕ)
  (c : J → ℕ) [inst_4 : Nonempty (Math115.IdealOracleScales.IdealStates r c)]
  (H : Math115.IdealOracleScales.IdealStates r c → ℝ),
  (Math115.IdealOracleScales.selectedChain r c).variance H ≤
    128 * 5 ^ 4 * ↑OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance ^ 17 *
      (Math115.IdealOracleScales.selectedChain r c).energy H

runtime_boundary.intermediate_powers: 17 is the mixing allowance power; 85 and 170 are reservation/size bounds, not a complete numeric runtime exponent.
runtime_boundary.proof_only_choice: tableDraw uses Classical.choose as a specification witness; publicDraw and its realizer execute the computed ordinary list draw, not tableDraw.
runtime_boundary.proved: Uniform polynomial-time existence for this fixed formal fair-bit machine; supplied reserved-word draw cost plus output weight is separately polynomial.
runtime_boundary.supplied_bank_scope: Cost theorems take the exact scheduled bank, allow all natural h, and require no equal-total premise. Precision h is numeric in encodeMargins.length+h+3. The separate finite-word machine compiler accounts for fair-bit acquisition.
runtime_boundary.unextracted: The source witnesses complete Dtime=170*P.natDegree for an existential physical-compiler polynomial P. No concrete numeric full runtime degree is extracted here.
